summary: SMFG filed a Form 6-K announcing revisions to share counts for its planned stock split, following the cancellation of a portion of its treasury shares. The total issued shares before the split decreased from 3,829,143,493 to 3,801,124,893, correspondingly reducing the split increase and post-split total to 7,602,249,786. This is an administrative update to a previously disclosed corporate action, not a special situation.
